summary: A guyed steel tower at Agnew Lake, Espanola went up in 1931 and was replaced by a steel tower in 1966; no recent site report found.

facts.design: Guyed steel tower (1931), 24 m (80 ft); replaced in 1966 by a self-supporting steel tower, 30.5 m (100 ft)
facts.status_note: Listed as still standing; no recent description of the site was found.

events.note: New self-supporting steel tower, 100 ft, replaced the earlier structure

evidence.quote: An eighty-foot guyed steel tower erected.

1966 self-supporting tower replaced the earlier structure

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, each a single entry on a non-official site: the Canada Lookouts page (1931 and 1966 dates) and an Ontario still-standing list (no date on the page). The firelookout.ca record is blank (Year Built and Structure Height N/A) and is not cited. The record name 'Baldwin Lake' differs from both sources, which give Baldwin Tower at Agnew Lake, Espanola; the record point (46.34221, -81.7136) matches the Ontario GeoHub tower layer point named 'Baldwin Fire Tower' (cached at data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson, tower ident SF-53). That layer has no date, height or status, and fetch_text cannot read the GeoHub page, so it is not cited. An editor may want to check the name. height_m 30.5 is the 1966 structure; no source says which structure stands now. No access, staffing or fire information was found. Searches used: three, one over this tower's two-search budget. Forest History Ontario and provincial archives were not checked.
